cards.name: Azure Policy
cards.az900ExamTip: Enforce organizational standards, assess compliance, and prevent non-compliant deployments at scale
cards.description: Rules engine that evaluates resources and automatically remediates or denies non-compliant configurations

cards.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
cards.az900ExamTip: Fine-grained access management enforcing the principle of least privilege through role assignments
cards.description: Grant granular access permissions to users, groups, and service principals on specific scopes

cards.name: Azure Resource Groups
cards.az900ExamTip: Logical container for resources that share the same lifecycle, permissions, and deployment boundaries
cards.description: Organizational unit that groups related cloud assets for unified administration and deletion

cards.name: Azure Resource Locks
cards.az900ExamTip: CanNotDelete prevents accidental deletion; ReadOnly prevents both modification and deletion
cards.description: Management locks applied at subscription, resource group, or resource scope to safeguard critical assets

cards.name: Resource Tags
cards.az900ExamTip: Name-value metadata pairs applied to resources to track cost centers, environments, and owners
cards.description: Taxonomy metadata facilitating automated chargeback billing, filtering, and governance reporting

cards.name: Microsoft Entra ID
cards.az900ExamTip: Cloud-based identity and access management service providing SSO, MFA, and Conditional Access
cards.description: Enterprise cloud directory securing user authentication, single sign-on, and hybrid directory sync

cards.name: Azure Key Vault
cards.az900ExamTip: Secure centralized repository for safeguarding cryptographic keys, secrets, certificates, and tokens
cards.description: Hardware Security Module (HSM) backed store eliminating plain-text credentials from source code

cards.name: Microsoft Cost Management
cards.az900ExamTip: Analyzes cloud spend, tracks resource usage patterns, and provides cost-saving recommendations
cards.description: Suite of financial governance tools for visualizing, allocating, and forecasting Azure expenditures

cards.name: Azure Budgets & Alerts
cards.az900ExamTip: Configures spending thresholds that trigger automated email notifications or action groups when exceeded
cards.description: Proactive spending limit guardrails alerting stakeholders before budget overruns occur

cards.name: Azure Pricing Calculator
cards.az900ExamTip: Web-based planning tool used to estimate expected monthly cloud consumption costs upfront
cards.description: Pre-deployment cost estimator allowing architectural design iteration against financial constraints

cards.name: Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Calculator
cards.az900ExamTip: Compares cost of running on-premises datacenter workloads against running in Azure over time
cards.description: Financial modeling tool analyzing server, storage, networking, and labor savings for migration

cards.name: Azure Monitor
cards.az900ExamTip: Comprehensive platform collecting metrics and logs from Azure resources, OS, and applications
cards.description: Unified observability engine driving alerts, autoscale triggers, and performance dashboards

cards.name: Log Analytics Workspace
cards.az900ExamTip: Central repository for log data supporting complex investigative queries using Kusto Query Language (KQL)
cards.description: Queryable big-data log sink powering deep diagnostic audits and security incident response

cards.name: Azure Advisor
cards.az900ExamTip: Personalized cloud consultant offering actionable advice across Reliability, Security, Cost, and Performance
cards.description: AI-guided recommendation engine inspecting deployed architectures to identify anti-patterns

cards.name: Azure Service Health
cards.az900ExamTip: Personalized dashboard notifying you of Azure service outages, planned maintenance, and health advisories
cards.description: Targeted notification portal tracking outages affecting your specific subscriptions and regions

cards.name: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
cards.az900ExamTip: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Cloud Workload Protection Platform (CWPP)
cards.description: Provides continuous security score assessments, regulatory compliance tracking, and threat protection

cards.name: Microsoft Sentinel
cards.az900ExamTip: Scalable cloud-native SIEM and SOAR solution delivering intelligent security analytics across enterprise
cards.description: Next-gen security information event management detecting and responding to multi-stage cyberattacks

cards.name: Azure Blueprints
cards.az900ExamTip: Package of role assignments, policies, ARM templates, and resource groups for repeatable environment setup
cards.description: Declarative orchestration tool deploying fully governed subscriptions aligned with compliance standards
